# Vote Dr. Reynoso by 11-03-26
Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART), District 4:
Building a Safer, Stronger, More Connected Bay Area
Visionary Leadership for the Future of Transit.
Dr. Luis Reynoso for BART stands for safer, smarter, and more reliable transit for the Bay Area. He supports strong service, secure stations, well-maintained facilities, and careful financial planning that makes the best use of public dollars. He also believes BART must look to the future by embracing new technologies that improve access, reduce costs, and make transit more convenient for riders. That includes modern options like robo-taxis to provide 24/7 mobility when trains are not running and to better connect people from the station to home. These innovations can help close late-night and first-mile, last-mile gaps while making the system more flexible, efficient, and competitive. Dr. Reynoso’s vision is simple: keep BART dependable today while building a transit network that is ready for tomorrow.
Alameda-Contra Costa County Transit District (ACTransit), Ward 5:
A Clear Vision for Safer, Smarter, More Reliable Transit
Forward-Looking Leadership for the East Bay.
Dr. Luis Reynoso for AC Transit stands for safer, smarter, and more reliable transit across the East Bay. He supports stronger bus service, better route planning, secure stations and stops, and careful financial stewardship that uses public funds wisely. He also believes AC Transit should embrace innovation to better serve riders, including exploring flexible technologies like robo-taxis and other new transit options for 24/7 service where traditional bus routes are not practical. These tools can help fill service gaps, improve access, reduce costs, and make transportation more convenient and environmentally responsible. Dr. Reynoso’s vision is to keep AC Transit dependable today while preparing it for the future with modern solutions that connect people to work, school, healthcare, and opportunity.
East Bay Municipal Utility District (EBMUD), Ward 7:
A Stronger Water Future for Every East Bay Community
Reliable Service. Responsible Leadership. Lasting Results.
Dr. Luis Reynoso stands for a simple idea: strong communities need strong water infrastructure. Safe, reliable water is essential to public health, local businesses, schools, and the stability of our economy. That means investing in the basics now. That means replacing aging pipes, modernizing treatment plants, and preparing for drought and climate stress before small problems become costly crises. These upgrades will help keep water clean, service dependable, and our neighborhoods resilient. He supports smart improvements for EBMUD, including pipeline replacement, treatment modernization, and conservation programs that cut waste and protect reliability. Just as important, he believes these projects must be managed with full transparency so residents know where every dollar goes and how construction will affect their communities. This is about practical leadership, responsible planning, and protecting the future we all share. Let’s invest wisely, demand accountability, and keep our water system strong without letting rates spiral out of control.
### 2026 (c) Vote for Dr. Luis Reynoso
